stem: Bilal notes that a cactus in a hot dry region has a thick stem that stores water and spines instead of broad leaves.

statements.text: The thick water-storing stem is an adaptation that helps the cactus survive in that dry region.
The spines instead of broad leaves are an adaptation that helps reduce water loss in that dry region.
Every feature of the cactus, including any accidental scratch mark on one spine, is an adaptation for the dry region.

teacher.key_rationale: Thick water-storing stems and spines that reduce water loss are desert adaptations. Treating every feature, including an accidental scratch, as an adaptation over-claims the idea (condition_omission / scope).
